preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of uppercase letters A-Z.
The input string length is between 1 and 1,000,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Kevin {}' if kevin_score > stuart_score else ('Stuart {}' if stuart_score > kevin_score else 'Draw')
postconditions.description: The output is 'Kevin {score}' if Kevin's total score is strictly greater than Stuart's, 'Stuart {score}' if Stuart's total score is strictly greater, or 'Draw' if scores are equal. The {score} is the winning player's total score.

postconditions.expression: kevin_score == sum(len([s for s in substrings if s[0] in 'AEIOU'])) and stuart_score == sum(len([s for s in substrings if s[0] in 'BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ']))
postconditions.description: Kevin's score is the sum of all occurrences of substrings starting with vowels (A, E, I, O, U), and Stuart's score is the sum of all occurrences of substrings starting with consonants (all other uppercase letters).

postconditions.expression: substrings == [stdin[i:j] for i in range(len(stdin)) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin)+1)]
postconditions.description: All possible non-empty substrings of the input string are considered, where a substring is defined as a contiguous sequence of characters from index i to j-1 (0-based).
